Fire Erupts Near New Delhi Railway Station Ticket Counter

A significant fire broke out near the ticket counter area of the New Delhi Railway Station. The incident caused panic among passengers. Three fire tenders were dispatched to the scene to douse the flames, which reportedly started in an ATM located outside the station.
